readings: For each invoice, compute the simple average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values (ignoring Quantity), and take the country from the invoice's customer (Customer.Country). The overall average is the mean of these per-invoice averages across all invoices. The deviation is the invoice's average unit price minus that overall mean, signed. A country's average deviation is the mean of the deviations of the invoices in that country. Return the top 10 invoices by (deviation minus the country's average deviation), highest first, with nulls last. Show invoice id, country, average unit price, deviation from the overall average, and deviation minus country average deviation, all unrounded.

For each invoice, compute the simple average of its InvoiceLine.UnitPrice values (ignoring Quantity), and take the country from the invoice's customer (Customer.Country). The overall average is the mean UnitPrice over all individual invoice lines in the database, so invoices with more lines weigh more. The deviation is the invoice's average unit price minus that line-level overall mean, signed. A country's average deviation is the mean of the deviations of the invoices in that country. Return the top 10 invoices by (deviation minus the country's average deviation), highest first, with nulls last. Show invoice id, country, average unit price, deviation from the overall average, and deviation minus country average deviation, all unrounded.
queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS overall_avg FROM inv
),
dev AS (
  SELECT inv.InvoiceId, inv.Country, inv.avg_price, inv.avg_price - overall.overall_avg AS deviation
  FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall
),
cdev AS (
  SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) AS country_avg_dev FROM dev GROUP BY Country
)
SELECT d.InvoiceId, d.Country, d.avg_price AS AvgUnitPrice, d.deviation AS Deviation, d.deviation - cd.country_avg_dev AS DeviationMinusCountryAvg
FROM dev d
JOIN cdev cd ON cd.Country = d.Country
ORDER BY (d.deviation - cd.country_avg_dev) IS NULL, DeviationMinusCountryAvg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS overall_avg FROM InvoiceLine
),
inv AS (
  SELECT il.InvoiceId AS InvoiceId,
         c.Country AS Country,
         AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
  JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  GROUP BY il.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
dev AS (
  SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price,
         avg_unit_price - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS deviation
  FROM inv
),
cdev AS (
  SELECT d.*,
         AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_avg_dev
  FROM dev d
)
SELECT InvoiceId,
       Country,
       avg_unit_price,
       deviation,
       deviation - country_avg_dev AS dev_minus_country_avg
FROM cdev
ORDER BY dev_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
